name: Alarm Dread
definition: The sudden jolt of pure panic that hits your chest when you hear a specific default ringtone out in public.
tip: That sound owns your morning.

name: Bibliomania
definition: The compulsive habit of buying beautiful books that you know you will never actually read.
tip: The unread stack is structural now.

name: Brain Fog
definition: That peculiar state where a basic thought enters your head and immediately gets lost in a thick grey mist.
tip: The connection is lagging.

name: Buyer's Remorse
definition: The immediate wave of profound regret and panic that hits the second after you purchase an expensive item.
tip: Why did I click buy?

name: Caffeine Addiction
definition: A dependency on caffeine to function normally, with withdrawal when skipped.
tip: Before or after — very different people.

name: Decision Fatigue
definition: The complete inability to choose between two equally unremarkable lunch options after making forty-seven decisions before noon.
tip: Every option is equally impossible now.

name: Doomscrolling
definition: The compulsive habit of sliding your thumb across a glass screen to find more terrible news you can do absolutely nothing about.
tip: Just one more swipe to find the bottom.

name: Earworm
definition: A single, repetitive pop song melody trapped in your head on an infinite, unstoppable loop.
tip: The song never ends.

name: FOMO
definition: The constant, agonising suspicion that everyone else is currently at the greatest party in human history without you.
tip: The party is somewhere else.

name: GPS Distrust
definition: The stubborn conviction that your satellite navigation app is actively plotting to trick you into driving down a boat ramp.
tip: The little blue arrow is lying to you.

name: Hanger
definition: The alarming emotional instability that occurs when your lunch is delayed by more than fifteen minutes.
tip: A sandwich is a matter of life or death.

name: Hypochondria
definition: Excessive worry about having a serious illness despite no medical evidence.
tip: The symptom checker is always open, never reassuring.

name: Impulse Shopping
definition: Compulsive, unplanned purchasing driven by emotion rather than need.
tip: The cart fills itself.

name: Misplaced Keys Panic
definition: The frantic, pocket-slapping ritual performed the exact moment you realise your keys have vanished from existence.
tip: They were in your hand five seconds ago.

name: Nail Biting
definition: A compulsive habit of chewing fingernails, usually driven by stress or anxiety.
tip: The nerves go somewhere.

name: Notification Fatigue
definition: The exhausted state where every digital ping feels like a personal attack on your peace of mind.
tip: The red dots are winning.

name: Parallel Parking Anxiety
definition: The sheer terror of attempting a tight reverse park while an impatient queue of drivers watches you fail.
tip: Everyone is watching you swing the wheel.

name: Road Rage
definition: Aggressive or volatile behaviour triggered by frustrating driving situations.
tip: The car does something to people.

name: Seat Guilt
definition: The agonising internal debate on public transport over whether you are morally obligated to surrender your plastic chair.
tip: Avoid eye contact to save your chair.

name: Social Hangover
definition: The profound exhaustion and mild regret that settles in after a social event where you spoke words to more than four people.
tip: All those conversations, and now you need a week.

name: Sunday Scaries
definition: The heavy cloud of impending doom and workplace anxiety that ruins a perfectly good Sunday afternoon.
tip: Monday is looming.

name: Superstition
definition: The firm belief that stepping on a sidewalk crack will genuinely disrupt the cosmic balance of your day.
tip: Don't step on the cracks.

name: Texting Anxiety
definition: The agonising state of watching three little dots bounce on a screen while waiting for a reply.
tip: Three moving dots are a lifetime.

name: White Coat Syndrome
definition: The bizarre spike in blood pressure that only occurs when you are sitting in a doctor's office.
tip: The chair is judging your health.

name: Workaholism
definition: The unshakeable conviction that your self-worth is entirely tied to your unread email count.
tip: A desk is a life raft.

name: Acrophobia
definition: A fear of heights, even in seemingly safe environments.
tip: A completely rational response to being very high up.

name: ADHD
definition: A neurodevelopmental condition affecting attention, focus, and impulse control.
tip: Seventeen tabs open. One of them is the right one.

name: Aerophobia
definition: A fear of flying or air travel.
tip: Statistically safe. Does not feel safe.

name: Agoraphobia
definition: The overwhelming belief that the great outdoors contains far too many unpredictable people and far too much open sky.
tip: The front door is a safety barrier.

name: Amaxophobia
definition: The terrifying belief that controlling a two-tonne metal box at high speeds is an entirely impossible task.
tip: You are steering a literal missile.

name: Aquaphobia
definition: A fear of water, particularly deep or open water.
tip: Makes beach holidays interesting.

name: Arachnophobia
definition: An intense fear of spiders and other arachnids.
tip: Eight legs is exactly seven too many.

name: Astrapophobia
definition: The urgent, childlike need to hide beneath a heavy blanket because the sky decided to make a very loud noise.
tip: The sky is shouting directly at you.

name: Claustrophobia
definition: A fear of enclosed or tight spaces.
tip: Some rooms are simply too personal.

name: Coulrophobia
definition: A fear of clowns.
tip: The balloons do not help.

name: Cynophobia
definition: The terrifying belief that even the tiniest, fluffiest puppy is secretly plotting your demise.
tip: A wagging tail can be misleading.

name: Deipnophobia
definition: The paralysing awkwardness of making polite small talk with semi-strangers while trying to chew gracefully.
tip: Pass the salt or face judgment.

name: Emetophobia
definition: The relentless vigilance of monitoring every person in the room for early signs they are about to ruin your evening.
tip: That person across the table looks slightly green.

name: Entomophobia
definition: The total tactical retreat from a room just because a tiny, multi-legged visitor decided to fly towards your face.
tip: If it has wings, the house belongs to it now.

name: Escalaphobia
definition: The distinct, split-second hesitation at the top of a moving staircase before stepping onto the metal teeth.
tip: The moving steel steps wait for no one.

name: Face Blindness
definition: The inability to recognise or distinguish faces, even very familiar ones.
tip: Every face is a mystery.

name: Ghost Vibration Syndrome
definition: The phantom physical sensation that your phone is buzzing in your pocket, prompting a sudden panic-check of an empty screen.
tip: Every twitch feels like a notification.

name: Glossophobia
definition: The paralysing realisation that everyone is watching you, and your vocabulary has suddenly dropped to zero.
tip: A podium is a very public trap.

name: Heliophobia
definition: An intense, vampire-like preference for the shadows on a perfectly beautiful summer day.
tip: SPF one million is a starting point.

name: Hemophobia
definition: A fear of blood, often causing fainting at the sight of it.
tip: The sight of it is the whole problem.

name: Hodophobia
definition: The overwhelming anxiety that leaving your immediate local area will result in a cascade of structural disasters.
tip: Every departure gate is a threat.

name: Insomnia
definition: Persistent difficulty falling or staying asleep, leaving the person chronically exhausted.
tip: It's 3am again.

name: Megalophobia
definition: The deep discomfort caused by looking at structures that are comically larger than a human being.
tip: A cruise ship is too much object.

name: Misophonia
definition: A fierce, primal urge to eliminate anyone who happens to be chewing their food slightly too loudly.
tip: A crunch is a declaration of war.

name: Mysophobia
definition: An obsessive fear of germs and contamination.
tip: There are never enough hand wipes.

name: Nomophobia
definition: The absolute cold panic that sets in when your pocket is empty and your digital lifeline is completely out of reach.
tip: A battery percentage is a countdown timer.

name: Nyctophobia
definition: A fear of the dark or darkness.
tip: It's probably nothing. Probably.

name: OCD
definition: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder — recurring intrusive thoughts relieved by compulsive behaviours.
tip: Once is not enough to be certain.

name: Ophidiophobia
definition: A fear of snakes.
tip: No arms, no trust.

name: Overthinking
definition: Excessive analysis of situations that prevents decisions, rest, or action.
tip: There's always one more angle to consider.

name: People Pleasing
definition: A compulsive need to gain others' approval and avoid conflict at personal cost.
tip: No is a complete sentence. And yet.

name: Perfectionism
definition: A relentless need for flawlessness that prevents satisfaction with any outcome.
tip: Nearly right is still wrong.

name: Procrastination
definition: Habitually delaying tasks despite knowing the negative consequences.
tip: Tomorrow is a perfect day for it.

name: Sciophobia
definition: The uneasy feeling that a dark shape on the wall is moving entirely independent of the object casting it.
tip: The shape on the wall is moving.

name: Seasonal Affective Disorder
definition: A type of depression closely linked to seasonal changes, most often occurring in winter.
tip: The calendar is predictable at least.

name: Somniphobia
definition: The uneasy suspicion that closing your eyes to drift off is a dangerous gamble where you might miss something vital.
tip: Going to sleep feels like a trap.

name: Split Personality
definition: A colloquial term for Dissociative Identity Disorder — multiple distinct identity states sharing one person.
tip: A rotating door of perspectives.

name: Submechanophobia
definition: The chilling dread of seeing human-made structures underwater, like a sunken boat or a pool drain.
tip: The pool drain is staring back.

name: Technophobia
definition: The deep conviction that a brand-new smart appliance is actively plotting to lock you out of your own house.
tip: The flashing blue light knows too much.

name: Thalassophobia
definition: The visceral dread of looking into dark open water and knowing you cannot see what is looking back.
tip: The ocean floor is very far down.

name: Triskaidekaphobia
definition: The profound structural suspicion that a specific two-digit integer is actively out to get you.
tip: Skip straight from twelve to fourteen.

name: Trypanophobia
definition: The intense anxiety caused by the sight of a needle, even if it is just sitting on a sterile counter.
tip: The smallest point is the sharpest threat.

name: Airport Mode
definition: The complete psychological shift into a hyper-efficient, passport-clutching operator who happily drinks beer at sunrise.
tip: Normal human time ends at security.

name: Alice in Wonderland Syndrome
definition: A bizarre neurological glitch where your surroundings suddenly appear comically oversized or tiny compared to your own body.
tip: The door handle is suddenly miles away.

name: Amnesia
definition: A significant and often sudden loss of memory.
tip: It was right there. Or somewhere.

name: Analysis Paralysis
definition: Inability to make a decision due to overthinking, resulting in no action at all.
tip: Every option needs just a bit more research.

name: Athazagoraphobia
definition: A fear of being forgotten, ignored, or replaced by others.
tip: The crowd doesn't notice. That's the point.

name: Burnout
definition: A state of chronic exhaustion and detachment caused by prolonged stress or overwork.
tip: Empty. Has been for a while.

name: Capgras Delusion
definition: A disorder in which a person believes a loved one has been replaced by an identical impostor.
tip: The people look right. But something's off.

name: Catastrophising
definition: A cognitive distortion that assumes the worst possible outcome in any situation.
tip: The path from here to disaster is very clear.

name: Chronophobia
definition: A fear of time passing or the inevitability of the future.
tip: Panic that doesn't have a shape.

name: Commuter Amnesia
definition: The eerie experience of driving completely on autopilot and arriving home with zero memory of the last twenty minutes.
tip: You arrived, but your mind stayed home.

name: Compulsive Lying
definition: A chronic pattern of automatic and habitual lying, often without clear motive.
tip: The story improves every telling.

name: Cotard's Syndrome
definition: A rare delusion in which a person believes they are dead, do not exist, or have lost their organs.
tip: A very unusual self-assessment.

name: Cryptomnesia
definition: A confusing mental glitch where you genuinely believe you just generated a brilliant idea that you actually read online yesterday.
tip: A genius idea that belongs to someone else.

name: Deja Vu
definition: The eerie and persistent feeling of having already experienced the current moment.
tip: You've been here before. Or felt like it.

name: Depersonalisation
definition: A persistent feeling of detachment from one's own body, thoughts, or identity.
tip: Watching yourself from slightly outside.

name: Dissociation
definition: A mental disconnection from thoughts, feelings, identity, or surroundings.
tip: Present in body. Elsewhere in mind.

name: Dunning-Kruger Effect
definition: The supreme, unshakeable confidence of being an absolute expert on a complex topic you only discovered five minutes ago.
tip: Expert status achieved in ten seconds.
aliases: thinking youre smart when youre not

name: Existential Dread
definition: An overwhelming anxiety about the nature, meaning, and purpose of existence.
tip: No good answers. Just the questions.

name: Gelotophobia
definition: A fear of being laughed at or ridiculed by others.
tip: Every laugh in the room is about you.

name: Imposter Syndrome
definition: A persistent belief that one's success is undeserved and will eventually be exposed.
tip: They're about to figure it out.

name: Intrusive Thoughts
definition: The sudden, bizarre impulse whispered by your brain to fling your expensive car keys directly into a deep storm drain.
tip: Your brain is suggesting a terrible idea.
aliases: brain telling me to do bad things

name: Kleptomania
definition: A compulsive urge to steal items, regardless of their value or any need for them.
tip: Pockets fill up fast.

name: Main Character Syndrome
definition: The delusion that your life is a cinematic masterpiece and everyone else is just an uncredited extra in your story.
tip: The spotlight follows only one.

name: Mandela Effect
definition: The eerie reality glitch where a whole room of people perfectly remembers a history that never happened.
tip: The cartoon bear never wore a monocle.

name: Narcolepsy
definition: A neurological disorder causing sudden, uncontrollable attacks of sleep.
tip: The timing is genuinely terrible.

name: Paris Syndrome
definition: The severe, overwhelming shock experienced when a famous holiday destination fails to match the flawless romantic version in your head.
tip: The postcard lied to you.

name: Phantom Destination Syndrome
definition: The sudden disorientation of waking up on a moving train and completely forgetting where you are going or who you are.
tip: The station outside looks completely alien.
aliases: waking up lost on a train

name: Phobophobia
definition: A fear of fear itself — the anxiety of experiencing anxiety.
tip: Being scared of being scared. Good luck.

name: Sleepwalking
definition: Moving around and performing actions while still fully asleep.
tip: Halfway between, going nowhere.

name: Stendhal Syndrome
definition: The severe shock of becoming so completely overwhelmed by a beautiful piece of art that you require medical attention.
tip: A painting should not cause dizziness.

name: Synesthesia
definition: A beautiful sensory mix-up where hearing a specific sound causes you to instantly taste or see a vibrant colour.
tip: Tuesday tastes like a cello.

name: Thanatophobia
definition: An intense fear of death or the process of dying.
tip: Universal. Most people just don't think about it.

name: Truman Show Delusion
definition: The persistent, uncanny suspicion that your entire life is a highly choreographed television series and everyone else is a paid actor.
tip: The camera angle is always slightly suspicious.
